replacements.name: hero_lede
replacements.old: Every answer arrives with a signed receipt you can check yourself — offline, in your own browser, with no server round-trip. When the model is not sure, it returns an honest BLOCKED instead of a confident guess.
replacements.new: Every governed state change produces a hash-chained receipt you can inspect offline, in your own browser. The interface says SIGNED only when persistent signer evidence is active and verification passes; otherwise it reports HASH-LINKED, UNSIGNED, DISABLED, or UNAVAILABLE. When the model is not sure, it returns an honest BLOCKED instead of a confident guess.

replacements.name: thesis_copy
replacements.old: Most AI asks for trust. a11oy earns it the way auditable systems do: every governed decision is sealed into a signed, hash-chained receipt; a trust gate can only tighten an answer, never wave it through; and the kernel rests on machine-checked theorems you can read. The honest part is the product — when a claim isn't proven, we label it, and you can open the check yourself.
replacements.new: Most AI asks for trust. a11oy earns it the way auditable systems do: every governed state change is recorded in a hash-chained receipt, while signer state and signature verification are disclosed separately and never inferred; a trust gate can only tighten an answer, never wave it through; and the kernel rests on machine-checked theorems you can read. The honest part is the product — when a claim isn't proven, we label it, and you can open the check yourself.

replacements.name: signing_pillar
replacements.old:
01 · SIGNS

It signs its work

DSSE receipts, ECDSA-P256 signed and SHA3-256 hash-chained into an append-only ledger. Signed on write, never on a read. Verify them in your own browser.
replacements.new:
01 · RECEIPTS

It proves receipt integrity and signer state

Every governed state change enters a SHA3-256 hash chain. DSSE / ECDSA-P256 is a separate cryptographic state and is labeled SIGNED only when persistent signer evidence is active and independent verification passes. Verify the disclosed state in your own browser.
